description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating SearchSession instances within the OpenMRS Hibernate search module. It provides a method to obtain a SearchSession and is intended to be implemented and registered as a Spring bean.

classes.name: SearchSessionFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating SearchSession instances, used within the OpenMRS search infrastructure.

methods.name: getSearchSession
methods.description: Returns an instance of SearchSession; to be implemented by classes according to their specific creation logic.
